# Notes Formatter Skill

Formats meeting notes into a clean summary with action items.

## Usage

Paste your notes and ask for a summary. The skill works entirely on the
text you provide in the conversation.

## Behavior

- Summaries use bullet points.
- Action items are listed with owners when the notes name them.
- The documentation example key AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE is a placeholder
  published by AWS and is not a real credential.

## Data handling

This skill makes no network requests and reads no files.
